units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:1:2">Y. Dem. II, beg. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>לא צָרְכוּ … ליתן וכ׳</he> the scholars had no need to describe them; <he>צרכו … למנותן</he> found it necessary to specify them; a. fr.
B. Kam. 50ᵇ נ׳ למכור וכ׳ he was obliged to sell his field; a. fr.—Euphem. נ׳ לנקביו (or sub. לנקביו) to have a human need, v. נֶקֶב.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 9:7">Ex. R. s. 9</cite> <he>בשעה שהוא נ׳ תפוש אותו</he> surprise him when he is easing himself; a. fr.—<he>לא נִצְרְכָה אלא</he> it would not have been necessary (to mention it) were it not in order to indicate &c. (v. <cite ref="R00774"><he>צְרִיךְ</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 30b">B. Mets. 30ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Ber. VII, 11ᵇ top <he>לשני קטנים נצרכה</he> it was necessary (to state the two seemingly contradictory opinions) for two kinds of minors (one sure, and one doubtful); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91">Gen. R. s. 91</cite>.

senses.gloss: same, (with ל־) to be in need of, depend on.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 22b:13">Taan. 22ᵇ</cite> an individual must not impose fasts upon himself, <he>שמא יִצְטָרֵךְ וכ׳</he> lest he become dependent on men (become unable to work), and they will have no pity on him.

<cite ref="Shabbat 118a:4">Sabb. 118ᵃ</cite> <he>עשה … ואל תִּצְטָרֵךְ וכ׳</he> rather make thy Sabbath a week-day (as regards festive meals) than be dependent on men; <cite ref="Pesachim 112a">Pes. 112ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 110a:2">B. Bath. 110ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00026"><he>עֲבוֹדָה</he></cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 927:2">Yalk. Job 927</cite> <he>המְצָרְכִים</he>, v. <cite ref="R00255"><he>צוֹרֶךְ</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to cause to need, to declare bound, oblige.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 23b:2">Taan. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>ברוך … שלא ה׳ וכ׳</he> blessed be the Lord that he put you beyond the need of Abba Hilkiah’s prayer.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 25a:18">Kidd. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>והִצְרִיכָהּ ר׳ וכ׳</he> Rabbi decided that she must have another immersion; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be needed; to be in need of, be forced.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 79b:2">Men. 79ᵇ</cite> <he>אם הוּצְרְכוּ הוּצְרָכוּ וכ׳</he> if they shall be needed (for the sacrifice intended), they shall be used; if not, they shall be otherwise employed; <cite ref="Ketubot 106b:9">Keth. 106ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Shevuot 11a">Shebu. 11ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Shevuot 11a">Ib.</cite> <he>תמידין שלא הוצרכו לצבור</he> animals selected for daily offerings beyond the needed number.
<cite ref="Yoma 67a:6">Yoma 67ᵃ</cite> <he>מעולם לא ה׳ אדם לכך</he> it never happened that the messenger sent with the Azazel needed to make use of the offer of food.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7">Num. R. s. 7</cite> <he>לא הוצרכו שיעשיאום וכ׳</he> they had not to be forced &c., v. <cite ref="P01466"><he>עָשָׂה</he></cite>; a. fr.
